$comment: Reference vectors for the file-provenance range grammar (SPEC.md 6.2.1, F17).
Each case names a resource, a range (absent = the whole resource), and either
the exact bytes the range addresses with their sha256 digest, or the reason
the range addresses nothing a verifier can digest ('unverifiable').
Resources and bytes are JSON strings: CR, LF and non-ASCII are exact, and a
reader must hash the UTF-8 encoding of the string with no normalization.
A diff to any value here changes which bytes a digest covers: wire-breaking (SPEC.md 15).

unverifiable_reasons.unrecognised: Not a line-range in the grammar: reserved, never a whole-resource fallback.
unverifiable_reasons.inverted: A line-range whose end precedes its start.
unverifiable_reasons.start_past_end: The range starts past the resource's last line.

cases.note: No range digests the whole resource (§6.2).
A single line includes its terminating LF.
The end is inclusive: two lines.
L2-2 addresses the same bytes as L2.
Every line: the whole resource.
An end past the last line clamps to it.
An end beyond any machine integer clamps too; the meaning does not depend on the verifier's integer width.
A start past the last line addresses nothing: unverifiable, not an empty digest.
An end before the start: unverifiable.
Lines are 1-indexed; 0 is not a line-number.
No leading zero: one spelling per line number.
No sign.
The L prefix is required.
The L prefix is uppercase only.
GitHub's L2-L3 is not this grammar.
A dash needs an end.
No surrounding whitespace.
Byte, character and column ranges are reserved, not defined.
An empty range is not the absent range; absent means the whole resource.
A final unterminated line runs to the end of the resource.
The reference fixtures' shape: an end past EOF over a short file.
CR is content: a CRLF line keeps both bytes.
Mixed endings are digested exactly as stored.
A final LF does not open an empty fourth line.
A bare CR is not a line terminator: the resource is one line.
So there is no line 2.
An empty line is a line: its bytes are its LF.
Blank and non-blank lines together.
Lines split on bytes; multi-byte UTF-8 is carried whole.
The whole of an empty resource is zero bytes.
An empty resource has zero lines.
